summary: Craft-specific and material-focused queries (hand block print, vegetable tanned leather, handwoven linen) consistently yield the highest quality scores, suggesting that precise technique or material descriptors outperform broad category terms. Inclusive and niche demographic fashion leads axis performance, while slow fashion and sustainable labels show strong consistency across multiple runs. Brand-name-anchored queries and site-domain hints (e.g., .in, shopify.com) underperform compared to descriptive craft-led queries, indicating that discovery works better when searching for product types rather than known brand names.
